Due to health recommendations  from the Center for Disease Control and State of California
Division of Occupational  Safety and Health ( Cal/
  OSHA),and the declared state of emergency
wherein  social  distancing  measures  have  been imposed or recommended, the CITY OF
S
AVALON'  CITY COUNCIL and PLANNING COMMISSION  MEETINGS SHALL GENERALLY
BE AVAILABLE TO THE  PUBLIC REMOTELY.  The
  general public may attend the meeting in
the Council Chambers however must adhere to social distancing  requirements and wear a mask
or face covering at all times. The public is encouraged to watch and participate from the safety

of their homes while practicing social distancing.

Council Chambers  areopen to a maximum 30 members of the general public. Once the Council
Chambers  reach  maximum  occupancy, the general  public may participate in Oral
Communication and address the City Council  agenda item in person by waiting in,the City
  on an

Hall Court Yard and entering the Chambers one at a time at the appropriate time. No one will be
admitted into the Council Chambers who is ill or exhibiting symptoms of COVID-  19.All
individuals entering the Council Chambers must wear a mask or face covering at all times.
Additionally, the general public may participate in Oral Communication and address the City
Council on an agenda items by providing comments via e -Comment. Please use the link below
to provide comments via e -Comment.

10.  Approval  of  Encroachment Permit for  frontage improvements  at  201  East

  Approved Resolution No. 22-20 of the City Council of the City of Avalon

  and Frontage Improvements within the Public Right -of -Way at 201 East Whittley;

  Approved encroachment permit for frontage improvements at 201 E. Whittley and
  authorized City Staff to negotiate with the property owners to determine the
  amounts of the required bond and liability insurance.
  Motion to approve made by Cinde Cassidy, seconded by Michael Ponce.
  All Ayes)

11.  Outdoor Dining Program Revisited
  Authorized implementation of an outdoor dining program with the addition of the
  space around Wrigley Stage as a dinning location until June 20, 2024, or, unless
  earlier rescinded by the City Council or City Manager. Outdoor dining is
  prohibited on special event days.
  Motion to approve made by Cinde Cassidy, seconded by Michael Ponce.
  All Ayes)
